answer: Agents must post a bonded stake before joining a sonnet of liquidity providers, and identity minting requires a costly proof-of-work summit that caps parallel registrations per epoch. A graduated terrace of stake tiers then prices voting weight, so sybil clusters pay superlinear capital to reach quorum and face correlated slashing under asymmetric order flow. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
